turns.answer:
A travel router with built-in VPN support lets you connect your phone, laptop, tablet, and other devices to one portable Wi-Fi network, while routing all their internet traffic through a VPN.

This is especially useful when traveling internationally, using hotel Wi-Fi, or wanting all your devices to share one VPN connection.

Important: Look for a router with a VPN client (WireGuard or OpenVPN), not merely VPN passthrough.
